entries.en: I nearly missed Storr's question because the room suddenly filled with applause.
entries.zh: 房间里突然响起掌声，我差点没听见施托尔的问题。

entries.en: The parcel we sent to Enniskillen came back with the address label torn.
entries.zh: 我们寄往恩尼斯基伦的包裹退回来了，地址标签已经撕破。

entries.en: Althorp paused on the steps to shake a pebble out of one boot.
entries.zh: 奥尔索普在台阶上停下来，想把一颗小石子从一只靴子里抖出来。

entries.en: Yusuf was the first to notice that the stage curtain had caught on a chair.
entries.zh: 优素福第一个注意到舞台帷幕被一把椅子挂住了。

entries.en: Smedley asked for a fresh sheet of paper after spilling tea over the seating plan.
entries.zh: 斯梅德利把茶洒在座位图上后，要了一张新纸。

entries.en: Rainey stepped back to see the whole painting through the crowded doorway.
entries.zh: 雷尼退后一步，想透过挤满人的门口看清整幅画。

entries.en: Millett held up the blue scarf, but nobody in the audience claimed it.
entries.zh: 米利特举起那条蓝围巾，但观众中没有人来认领。

entries.meaningZh: 马拉多纳〔特指球星 Diego Maradona〕
entries.en: A framed photograph of Diego Maradona stood beside the boy's collection of football cards.
entries.zh: 一张装裱好的迭戈·马拉多纳的照片摆在男孩收藏的足球卡旁边。

entries.en: Jiang noticed a small tear in the tent just as the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 刚开始下雨，姜就发现帐篷上有一道小裂口。

entries.en: Auxerre told us to keep the numbered slips until the raffle had finished.
entries.zh: 奥塞尔让我们留着那些编号纸条，直到抽奖结束。

entries.en: An angell stood beside the sleeping child in the old tale.
entries.zh: 那个古老故事里，一位天使站在熟睡的孩子身旁。

entries.en: The bag under Stoddart's chair began to move, and a kitten climbed out.
entries.zh: 斯托达特椅子底下的袋子动了起来，一只小猫爬了出来。

entries.en: Pollitt read the menu twice before noticing the date printed at the top.
entries.zh: 波利特把菜单看了两遍，才注意到顶部印着的日期。

entries.en: The illustrator erased the background but kept the peto in the foreground.
entries.zh: 插画师擦去了背景，却保留了前景中的刺鲅。

entries.en: Craigavon kept his finger on our place in the score while the conductor spoke.
entries.zh: 指挥说话时，克雷加文一直用手指按着乐谱中我们演奏到的位置。

entries.en: She unfolded an old map of the state of Penang beside the reading lamp.
entries.zh: 她在阅读灯旁展开了一张槟城州的旧地图。

entries.en: The envelope contained an old invoice from Matsushita Electric, folded into four.
entries.zh: 信封里装着一张折成四层的松下电器旧发票。

entries.en: Kinnear started laughing when the dog returned with the wrong slipper.
entries.zh: 狗带回的拖鞋不对，金尼尔笑了起来。

entries.en: Auerbach left the last page blank because the ink was almost gone.
entries.zh: 奥尔巴赫把最后一页空着没写，因为墨水快用完了。

entries.en: Allenby could not see the chalk marks until someone moved the stack of cushions.
entries.zh: 有人挪开那摞坐垫，艾伦比才看见粉笔记号。

entries.en: Monro borrowed a magnifying glass to examine the stamp on the envelope.
entries.zh: 门罗借了一面放大镜，想仔细看看信封上的邮票。

entries.en: MacLaren put his name on the waiting list and went back to work.
entries.zh: 麦克拉伦把自己的名字加到候补名单上，然后回去工作了。

entries.en: Hambleton was explaining the route when the lights in the hall went out.
entries.zh: 大厅的灯熄灭时，汉布尔顿正在说明路线。

entries.en: A torn map of Coatbridge lay beneath the old theatre programme.
entries.zh: 一张撕破的科特布里治地图放在那份旧剧院节目单下面。

entries.en: Mundi tried the side entrance after finding the main gate chained shut.
entries.zh: 蒙迪发现正门被铁链拴住后，试了试侧门。

entries.en: Farouk glanced at the clock and started gathering the scattered playing cards.
entries.zh: 法鲁克瞥了一眼钟，开始收拢散放的扑克牌。

entries.en: Ballantyne could hear music from the next room but could not recognise the tune.
entries.zh: 巴兰坦听得见隔壁房间的音乐，却认不出是什么曲子。

entries.en: Southwold made a paper hat while the children searched for the costume box.
entries.zh: 孩子们找装戏服的箱子时，索思沃尔德做了一顶纸帽。

entries.en: Maddox asked us not to whistle while the microphones were being tested.
entries.zh: 试麦克风时，马多克斯请我们不要吹口哨。

entries.en: Baptiste found a small bell sewn into the lining of the old coat.
entries.zh: 巴普蒂斯特发现，那件旧外套的衬里缝着一个小铃铛。

entries.en: Peres waited by the counter while the shop assistant searched for the missing receipt.
entries.zh: 店员找丢失的收据时，佩雷斯在柜台旁等着。

entries.en: Layton leaned closer to the glass case without touching it.
entries.zh: 莱顿向玻璃展示柜凑近了些，但没碰它。

entries.en: Abdel left enough room on the bench for two more visitors.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒在长凳上空出了足够让另外两位访客坐的位置。

entries.en: The model of a roker was too wide to fit into the smaller display case.
entries.zh: 那条鳐鱼的模型太宽，放不进较小的展示柜。

entries.en: Glendinning checked the play's title before buying a second ticket.
entries.zh: 格伦迪宁买第二张票之前，先核对了剧名。

entries.en: Algernon searched his bag for a pencil while the rest of us waited.
entries.zh: 我们其他人等着的时候，阿尔杰农在自己的包里找铅笔。

entries.en: Jacko arrived with a drawing rolled inside a length of cardboard tubing.
entries.zh: 亚茨科到来时，带着一幅卷在一段硬纸筒里的画。

entries.en: Herriot lowered the basket gently when a sleepy kitten peered out.
entries.zh: 一只睡意未消的小猫往外张望时，赫里欧轻轻地放低了篮子。

entries.en: Makepeace passed the biscuits around before anyone had time to ask for them.
entries.zh: 还没等人开口要，梅克皮斯就把饼干传给了大家。

entries.en: The museum displayed a block of white blanco beside a pair of canvas shoes.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一双帆布鞋旁展示了一块白色的布兰可擦白剂。

entries.en: A dropped marble rolled under Clermont's desk during the silent examination.
entries.zh: 安静的考试过程中，一颗掉落的弹珠滚到了克莱蒙特的桌子下面。

entries.en: Everard hung his wet coat on the only hook that was still empty.
entries.zh: 埃弗拉德把自己的湿外套挂在唯一还空着的挂钩上。

entries.meaningZh: 泰伯恩〔伦敦历史刑场名〕
entries.en: The guide turned the old print of Tyburn towards the group.
entries.zh: 导览员把那张泰伯恩刑场的旧版画转向众人。

entries.en: Judi waved from the balcony, holding the umbrella we had been searching for.
entries.zh: 朱迪从阳台上向我们挥手，手里拿着我们一直在找的雨伞。

entries.en: Brownlow folded the map along its old creases and slipped it into a jacket pocket.
entries.zh: 布朗洛沿着旧折痕折好地图，把它塞进夹克口袋。

entries.meaningZh: 邋遢的人〔贬义，尤指女人〕
entries.en: The narrator dismisses a neighbour as a dowd without describing anything she has done.
entries.zh: 叙述者把一位邻居贬为邋遢女人，却没有描述她做过什么。

entries.en: Hebden found the missing drumstick wedged behind the rehearsal room's radiator.
entries.zh: 赫布登发现，丢失的那根鼓槌卡在排练室的暖气片后面。

entries.en: In the story, a Maronite befriends the bookseller who opens a shop next door.
entries.zh: 故事里，一位马龙派教徒和在隔壁开店的书商成了朋友。

entries.en: Raynor counted the costumes again when a second group arrived for the performance.
entries.zh: 第二批人来参加演出时，雷纳又数了一遍戏服。

entries.en: Dewi tied a ribbon around her suitcase so she could recognise it more easily.
entries.zh: 黛维在自己的行李箱上系了条丝带，方便辨认。

entries.en: Slobodan lifted the lid just far enough to let the steam escape.
entries.zh: 斯洛博丹把盖子稍稍掀开，让蒸汽逸出。

entries.en: He pinned an old chart of the Nikkei above the notes for his presentation.
entries.zh: 他把一张日经指数的旧图表钉在自己的演示笔记上方。

entries.en: Jobson stopped the recording when a telephone began ringing in the background.
entries.zh: 背景中响起电话铃声时，乔布森停止了录音。

entries.meaningZh: 金卡丁郡〔苏格兰旧郡名〕
entries.en: The exhibition included a hand-coloured map of the former county of Kincardine.
entries.zh: 展览中有一张金卡丁旧郡的手工着色地图。

entries.en: Canaletto offered to carry the awkward parcel while I unlocked the door.
entries.zh: 我开门锁时，卡纳莱托提出帮忙拿着那个不便搬拿的包裹。

entries.en: Bolger heard a faint tapping sound from inside the empty cupboard.
entries.zh: 博尔杰听见空橱柜里传出轻微的敲击声。

entries.en: Selborne sketched the broken hinge before taking the cabinet apart.
entries.zh: 塞尔伯恩拆开柜子之前，先画下了断裂合页的样子。

entries.en: The crowd cheered as Mullin caught the ball just above the fence.
entries.zh: 马林在围栏上方接住了球，人群欢呼起来。

entries.en: Dolan returned the borrowed ladder with a fresh tin of paint balanced on one step.
entries.zh: 多兰归还借来的梯子时，在一级梯阶上稳稳放着一罐新油漆。

entries.en: She planted clary beside the path and marked the spot with a short wooden stake.
entries.zh: 她在小径旁种了鼠尾草属的植物，并用一根短木桩标出了位置。

entries.meaningZh: 更迷离的〔trippy 的比较级，俚语〕
entries.en: The second projection looked trippier, with colours sliding across the ceiling.
entries.zh: 第二段投影看起来更加迷离，色彩在天花板上滑动。

entries.en: The editor moved the final stich onto a new page to keep the poem's layout clear.
entries.zh: 编辑把最后一个诗行移到新的一页，以使诗的版面清晰。

entries.en: Montgomerie recognised the tune after only a few notes from the violin.
entries.zh: 小提琴才奏出几个音，蒙哥马利就认出了那首曲子。

entries.en: Helmsley stood aside so the person carrying the cello could pass.
entries.zh: 赫尔姆斯利站到一旁，让拿着大提琴的人通过。

entries.en: McCluskey packed the fragile model between two thick layers of foam.
entries.zh: 麦克拉斯基把那个易碎模型夹在两层厚泡沫之间包装好。

entries.en: Midgley lowered the music when someone knocked on the studio door.
entries.zh: 有人敲工作室的门时，米奇利调低了音乐的音量。

entries.en: The bookseller asked for the ISBN because several editions shared the same cover design.
entries.zh: 几种版本用了相同的封面设计，所以书商询问了国际标准书号。

entries.en: Andersson spotted a loose screw beneath the chair and fetched a small screwdriver.
entries.zh: 安德森发现椅子底下有颗松动的螺丝，便取来了一把小螺丝刀。

entries.en: An old letter from McKinsey had been filed among the theatre's programmes.
entries.zh: 一封麦肯锡寄来的旧信被归在了剧院的节目单中。

entries.en: Donny used an empty envelope to keep the tiny puzzle pieces together.
entries.zh: 唐尼用一个空信封装着那些小小的拼图块，免得散失。

entries.en: Beith had almost finished the puzzle when the cat jumped onto the table.
entries.zh: 比思快拼完拼图时，猫跳上了桌子。

entries.en: Arun asked everyone to leave a clear path between the chairs and the exit.
entries.zh: 阿伦请大家在椅子和出口之间留出一条畅通的路。

entries.en: Steffi discovered a folded note tucked into the back of the photograph frame.
entries.zh: 施特菲发现相框背面塞着一张折好的便条。

entries.en: Shiel lifted the microphone stand until the singer could use it comfortably.
entries.zh: 希尔抬高了麦克风支架，直到歌手能舒适地使用它。

entries.en: Javed brought an extra pair of gloves for anyone who wanted to help with the garden.
entries.zh: 贾韦德多带了一副手套，供愿意帮忙打理花园的人使用。

entries.en: Guillermo stopped halfway through the story when he realised the children were asleep.
entries.zh: 吉列尔莫讲故事讲到一半，发现孩子们都睡着了，便停了下来。

entries.en: She added a serrano to the empty bowl before cutting the other peppers.
entries.zh: 她先往空碗里放了一个墨西哥辣椒，再切其他辣椒。

entries.en: The old photograph from Rossendale had a handwritten message on the back.
entries.zh: 那张来自罗森代尔的旧照片背面有一段手写留言。

entries.en: Georgi held the torch while I looked for the bolt beneath the workbench.
entries.zh: 我找工作台下面的螺栓时，格奥尔基拿着手电筒。

entries.en: Enrique wrote the new address on the back of an unused ticket.
entries.zh: 恩里克把新地址写在一张未用过的票的背面。

entries.en: The envelope from Dundalk, Ireland, reached us with one corner badly torn.
entries.zh: 从爱尔兰邓多克寄来的信封送到我们这里时，一个角已经撕得很厉害。

entries.meaningZh: 商业与技术教育委员会〔历史机构名〕
entries.en: An old letter from the Business and Technology Education Council, BTEC, lay among the school records.
entries.zh: 学校档案中放着一封商业与技术教育委员会寄来的旧信。

entries.en: Trueman turned the little wooden wheel, but nothing inside the model moved.
entries.zh: 特鲁曼转动了那个小木轮，但模型里面什么也没动。

entries.en: She compared two old diagrams of the Bunter before returning the books to the shelf.
entries.zh: 她比较了两张本特地层的旧示意图，然后把书放回架子。

entries.en: Mobutu pushed a folded newspaper under the wobbling table leg.
entries.zh: 蒙博托把一张折好的报纸塞到那条晃动的桌腿下面。

entries.en: Delo stepped off the path to avoid a line of marching ants.
entries.zh: 德洛走到小径旁边，避开一队爬行的蚂蚁。

entries.meaningZh: 文尼〔男子名，Vincent 的昵称〕
entries.en: Vinny closed his notebook when the lights dimmed for the next performance.
entries.zh: 灯光为下一场表演调暗时，文尼合上了自己的笔记本。

entries.en: Roskill waited until the applause faded before introducing the final speaker.
entries.zh: 罗斯基尔等掌声渐渐平息后，才介绍最后一位发言者。

entries.en: Payton balanced the tray carefully as the train rounded a bend.
entries.zh: 火车转弯时，佩顿小心地端稳托盘。

entries.en: A faded poster for Anwar had been rolled up beside the cinema's old ticket machine.
entries.zh: 一张褪色的《艾乃哇尔》海报被卷起来，放在电影院的旧售票机旁边。

entries.en: The archivist placed the Comintern documents in a separate folder before photographing them.
entries.zh: 档案管理员先把共产国际的文件放进一个单独的文件夹，再给它们拍照。

entries.meaningZh: 东京〔越南北部地区旧称〕
entries.en: The map of Tonkin was too faded for us to read the smaller labels.
entries.zh: 那张东京地区的地图褪色太严重，我们看不清较小的标注。

entries.en: Palo could not find a clean brush, so the painting had to wait.
entries.zh: 帕洛找不到干净的画笔，只好暂时不画。

entries.en: Withington noticed the mirror was crooked and gently straightened it.
entries.zh: 威辛顿发现镜子歪了，便轻轻把它摆正。

entries.en: Mountjoy squeezed the water from the sponge into a bucket before wiping the windowsill.
entries.zh: 芒乔伊先把湿海绵里的水挤进桶里，再擦窗台。

entries.en: The envelope from Broome contained a photograph and a short handwritten message.
entries.zh: 从布鲁姆寄来的信封里装着一张照片和一段简短的手写留言。

entries.en: Adolph repaired the paper crown with a narrow strip of sticky tape.
entries.zh: 阿道夫用一条窄胶带修好了纸王冠。

entries.en: A photograph of a Pyrenean valley hung above the battered suitcase.
entries.zh: 一张比利牛斯山脉山谷的照片挂在那只破旧的行李箱上方。

entries.en: She bought a second-hand map of Omagh with a corner missing.
entries.zh: 她买了一张缺了一个角的二手奥马地图。

entries.en: Bolsover listened to the entire recording before suggesting any changes.
entries.zh: 博尔索弗听完了整段录音，才提出修改建议。

entries.en: Aldrich spread a cloth beneath the easel to catch the dripping paint.
entries.zh: 奥德里奇在画架下面铺了一块布，用来接滴落的颜料。

entries.en: Ewen opened the parcel cautiously, expecting something fragile inside.
entries.zh: 埃文小心翼翼地打开包裹，觉得里面可能有易碎的东西。

entries.en: Seddon asked the dancers to begin again from the quiet section of the music.
entries.zh: 塞登请舞者们从音乐中轻柔的那一段重新开始。

entries.en: Goebbel laid the coloured tiles on the floor to compare their patterns.
entries.zh: 格贝尔把彩色瓷砖铺在地板上，以便比较它们的图案。

entries.en: Pyke put the still-damp poster beside an open window to dry.
entries.zh: 派克把还湿着的海报放在一扇开着的窗户旁晾干。

entries.en: Muldoon returned with a longer rope after measuring the distance between the posts.
entries.zh: 马尔登量了柱子之间的距离后，带着一根更长的绳子回来了。

entries.en: Soane switched off the fan so the loose pages would stop blowing around.
entries.zh: 索恩关掉了风扇，不让散开的纸张再到处乱飞。

entries.en: Molyneux was still searching for a matching button when the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到时，莫利纽还在找一颗相配的纽扣。

entries.en: Joshi carried the cake through the doorway while the others held their breath.
entries.zh: 乔希端着蛋糕穿过门口，其他人都屏住了呼吸。

entries.en: Coton lifted the rug and found the key that everyone had been searching for.
entries.zh: 库顿掀起地毯，找到了大家一直在找的钥匙。

entries.en: Goffman handed out the blank cards after explaining the rules of the game.
entries.zh: 戈夫曼说明游戏规则后，分发了空白卡片。

entries.en: Nuttall kept the empty seat beside the aisle for a late arrival.
entries.zh: 纳托尔把过道旁的空座留给一位迟到的人。

entries.en: The faded photograph of the Murchison River had a crease across its centre.
entries.zh: 那张褪色的默奇森河照片中间有一道折痕。

entries.en: A letter addressed to Kidlington had slipped between the pages of the atlas.
entries.zh: 一封寄往基德灵顿的信滑进了地图册的书页之间。

entries.en: Maskell took off one glove to untie the knot in the string.
entries.zh: 马斯克尔脱下一只手套，想解开细绳上的结。

entries.meaningZh: 使非洲化〔Africanize 的过去式〕
entries.en: In the workshop, the director Africanized the play by setting its story in Ghana.
entries.zh: 在工作坊里，导演把戏的故事背景设在加纳，使它非洲化了。

entries.en: Horan propped the door open with a shoe while the musicians carried their instruments inside.
entries.zh: 乐手们把乐器搬进去时，霍兰用一只鞋抵住门，让门开着。

entries.en: Flannery turned the box upside down, hoping the last bead would fall out.
entries.zh: 弗兰纳里把盒子倒了过来，希望最后一颗珠子能掉出来。

entries.en: Casson tried to mend the kite, but the paper tore again near the frame.
entries.zh: 卡森试着修风筝，但纸在骨架附近又撕裂了。

entries.en: Ronny left a space on the shelf for the books still waiting downstairs.
entries.zh: 龙尼在架子上空出了一处地方，留给还放在楼下的那些书。

entries.en: Kristeva shook the snow from the umbrella before stepping into the narrow hallway.
entries.zh: 克里斯蒂娃抖掉伞上的雪，才走进狭窄的门厅。

entries.en: Queenie held her bag against her chest as the dancers hurried past.
entries.zh: 舞者们匆匆经过时，奎尼把自己的包抱在胸前。

entries.en: Newall put the cracked cup aside so nobody would use it by mistake.
entries.zh: 纽沃尔把有裂纹的杯子放在一边，免得有人误用。

entries.en: Mulroney went back for the tickets after reaching the end of the street.
entries.zh: 穆罗尼走到街尾后，又回去取票了。

entries.en: Ferrier tapped the glass twice to attract the waiter without interrupting the conversation.
entries.zh: 费里尔轻敲了两下杯子，想在不打断谈话的情况下引起服务员的注意。

entries.en: The model of Conwy Castle needed a wider base before we could put it on display.
entries.zh: 我们得先给康威城堡的模型配一个更宽的底座，才能把它展出。

entries.en: Augusto pulled the curtain aside and discovered a second door behind it.
entries.zh: 奥古斯托拉开帘子，发现后面还有一扇门。

entries.en: Yakovlev marked the damaged pages with small pieces of paper instead of folding their corners.
entries.zh: 雅科夫列夫用小纸片标出破损的书页，没有折页角。

entries.en: Mandelson was halfway down the stairs when someone called him back for a photograph.
entries.zh: 曼德尔森下楼下到一半时，有人叫他回去拍照。

entries.en: Katrina marked her place with a ribbon and closed the heavy book.
entries.zh: 卡特里娜用丝带标出自己读到的位置，然后合上了那本厚书。

entries.en: Legge spread the wet gloves over a chair near the radiator.
entries.zh: 莱格把湿手套摊在暖气片附近的一把椅子上。

entries.meaningZh: 威尔德地层的〔地质用语〕
entries.en: The old sketch showed Wealden strata beneath a line of carefully drawn trees.
entries.zh: 那张旧素描画出了威尔德地层，上面是一排精心描绘的树。

entries.meaningZh: 维尼〔男子名，Vinny 的另一拼法〕
entries.en: Vinnie checked his pockets again when the cloakroom attendant asked for the numbered ticket.
entries.zh: 衣帽间管理员索要号码票时，维尼又检查了一遍自己的口袋。

entries.en: Vasco climbed onto the stool to reach a jar on the highest shelf.
entries.zh: 瓦斯科爬上凳子，想拿到最高一层架子上的罐子。

entries.en: Nawaz had to stop reading when the children began practising their drums upstairs.
entries.zh: 孩子们开始在楼上练鼓时，纳瓦兹不得不停下阅读。

entries.en: Colvin counted the empty chairs before bringing another table into the room.
entries.zh: 科尔文先数了数空椅子，才又搬了一张桌子进房间。

entries.en: Miliband moved the vase away from the table's edge as the puppy came closer.
entries.zh: 小狗走近时，米利班德把花瓶从桌边往里移了移。

entries.en: Cusack reached the platform just in time to see the last train leave.
entries.zh: 丘萨克赶到站台时，恰好看见末班火车开走。

entries.en: Yorke laid the broken umbrella on the floor and borrowed a dry coat.
entries.zh: 约克把坏伞放在地板上，借了一件干外套。

entries.en: Warton wrapped each shell separately before placing it in the shallow box.
entries.zh: 沃顿把每个贝壳分别包好，再放进那个浅盒子里。

entries.en: Sturge searched the empty stage for a small silver earring.
entries.zh: 斯特奇在空舞台上寻找一只小银耳环。

entries.en: Fennell handed the chalk to the next player without revealing the answer.
entries.zh: 芬内尔把粉笔递给下一位游戏参与者，没有透露答案。

entries.meaningZh: 勃艮第的〔法国地名形容词〕
entries.en: She arranged photographs of Burgundian villages across the table before choosing one for the cover.
entries.zh: 她把勃艮第村庄的照片在桌上摆开，然后选了一张作封面。

entries.en: Christabel pulled a chair closer so she could hear the old recording.
entries.zh: 克丽斯特贝尔把椅子拉近了一些，以便听清那段旧录音。

entries.en: Olson left a note beside the jammed drawer so nobody would pull it too hard.
entries.zh: 奥尔森在卡住的抽屉旁留了张便条，免得有人用力过猛。

entries.meaningZh: 弗洛丽〔女子名，Florence 的昵称〕
entries.en: Florrie dried her hands before taking the photographs out of their envelope.
entries.zh: 弗洛丽先擦干自己的手，再把照片从信封里取出来。

entries.en: Salmond covered the keyboard with a cloth before sanding the wooden window frame.
entries.zh: 萨蒙德先用布盖住键盘，再打磨木窗框。

entries.en: Profumo moved a little closer to the speaker because the audience had begun to whisper.
entries.zh: 观众开始窃窃私语，普罗富莫便向发言者靠近了一点。

entries.en: Bonnard waved us towards the smaller room, where the chairs had already been arranged.
entries.zh: 勃纳尔招手让我们去小一些的房间，那里的椅子已经摆好了。

entries.en: Redpath tucked the loose end of the scarf into a coat pocket.
entries.zh: 雷德帕思把围巾散垂的一端塞进了外套口袋。

entries.en: Cryer opened the biscuit tin and found a sewing kit instead.
entries.zh: 克赖尔打开饼干盒，却发现里面装的是针线包。

entries.en: Grubb stayed behind to help fold the tables after the jumble sale.
entries.zh: 旧物义卖结束后，格拉布留下来帮忙折叠桌子。

entries.en: Ralf drew a curtain across the doorway to keep the bright light off the screen.
entries.zh: 拉尔夫在门口拉上帘子，不让强光照到屏幕上。

entries.en: Milroy stopped turning the handle when the wooden gears began to squeak.
entries.zh: 木齿轮开始吱吱响时，米尔罗伊停止了转动把手。

entries.en: Collinson reached for the empty jug and offered to refill it.
entries.zh: 柯林森伸手去拿空水壶，提出再灌满它。

entries.meaningZh: 克雷布〔源指英国作家、语文学家〕
entries.en: The curator moved the portrait of the philologist Crabb away from the leaking skylight.
entries.zh: 策展人把语文学家克雷布的肖像移到远离漏水天窗的地方。

entries.en: Marek found the missing glove inside a sleeve of the borrowed jacket.
entries.zh: 马雷克在借来的夹克的一只袖子里找到了丢失的手套。

entries.en: Fernand opened the window a little wider so we could hear the distant band.
entries.zh: 费尔南德把窗户开大了一点，让我们能听见远处乐队的声音。

entries.en: Heslop left the torch on the stairs while carrying the heavy box down.
entries.zh: 赫斯洛普把那只沉箱子搬下去时，把手电筒留在了楼梯上。

entries.en: Libor caught the falling programme before it landed in the puddle.
entries.zh: 节目单还没掉进水坑，利博尔就接住了它。

entries.en: Bashir held the curtain steady while the others checked its length.
entries.zh: 其他人检查帘子的长度时，巴希尔扶稳了帘子。

entries.en: Petr looked behind the cushions and discovered the remote control beside a toy car.
entries.zh: 彼得往靠垫后面一看，发现遥控器在一辆玩具车旁边。

entries.en: Dessie asked for another pencil after the point snapped during the sketching session.
entries.zh: 素描活动中铅笔尖断了，德西埃便又要了一支铅笔。

entries.en: Monie slipped a sheet of cardboard beneath her drawing before carrying it outside.
entries.zh: 莫尼把一张硬纸板垫在自己的画下面，才把画拿到外面去。

entries.en: Mahmud waited for the kettle to boil while the others set out the cups.
entries.zh: 其他人摆杯子时，马哈茂德等着水壶里的水烧开。

entries.en: Whitehill stopped the trolley before it bumped into the stack of empty crates.
entries.zh: 手推车还没撞上那摞空箱子，怀特希尔就把它停住了。

entries.en: Terri checked her shopping bag and realised she had left the bread on the shop counter.
entries.zh: 特丽检查了自己的购物袋，才意识到把面包忘在柜台上了。

entries.en: Stannard was still untangling the cable when the audience began to arrive.
entries.zh: 观众开始入场时，斯坦纳德还在理顺缠绕的电缆。

entries.en: An unfinished watercolour of the Mourne Mountains stood on the easel by the window.
entries.zh: 窗边的画架上放着一幅尚未完成的莫恩山脉水彩画。

entries.en: A postcard from Pereira had been pinned above the desk for years.
entries.zh: 一张从佩雷拉寄来的明信片已经在书桌上方钉了好几年。

entries.en: Jaruzelski brushed the dust off the lid before opening the wooden chest.
entries.zh: 雅鲁泽尔斯基先拂去盖子上的灰尘，再打开木箱。

entries.en: The invitation from Cavan arrived inside an envelope covered with small stamps.
entries.zh: 从卡文寄来的请柬装在一个贴满小邮票的信封里。

entries.en: Mello reached under the bench and retrieved the ball without disturbing the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 梅洛伸手到长凳底下拿回了球，没有惊动睡着的狗。

entries.en: Joao was arranging the photographs when a loose page fell out of the album.
entries.zh: 若昂整理照片时，相册里掉出了一张散页。

entries.en: The historian enlarged a photograph of a bridge over the Farah River.
entries.zh: 那位历史学者放大了一张法拉赫河上一座桥的照片。

entries.en: Cresson stood behind the curtain until the applause for the previous performer had faded.
entries.zh: 克雷森站在帘子后面，等着给上一位表演者的掌声平息。

entries.en: The archivist found an old letter from the American National Standards Institute, ANSI, inside the folder.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在文件夹里发现了一封美国国家标准学会寄来的旧信。

entries.en: Nevin left his bicycle by the gate and walked across the muddy yard.
entries.zh: 内文把自己的自行车放在大门旁，步行穿过泥泞的院子。

entries.en: Karim pointed to a small hole in the tent before the others began unpacking their bags.
entries.zh: 其他人还没开始取出包里的东西，卡里姆就指了指帐篷上的一个小洞。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the diagram of the genus Candida before printing the classroom poster.
entries.zh: 插画师放大了念珠菌属的示意图，然后印制课堂海报。

entries.en: The collector kept an old Atari advertisement between two sheets of clear plastic.
entries.zh: 收藏者把一张雅达利的旧广告夹在两张透明塑料片之间保存。

entries.en: Layfield carried the empty flowerpots back to the shed in a wicker basket.
entries.zh: 莱菲尔德用一个编织篮把空花盆搬回了棚屋。

entries.meaningZh: 乡间邸宅〔西班牙语地区等用语〕
entries.en: We spent the afternoon in the quinta's shaded courtyard while the rain soaked the garden.
entries.zh: 雨水浸湿花园时，我们在那座乡间邸宅阴凉的庭院里度过了一个下午。

entries.en: Grierson tried to turn the page without waking the kitten asleep on the book.
entries.zh: 格里尔森试着翻页，尽量不弄醒睡在书上的小猫。

entries.en: Eglinton noticed the loose floorboard and warned the next visitor to step around it.
entries.zh: 埃格林顿注意到地板有一块松了，便提醒下一位访客绕开。

entries.en: Pegg folded the wet umbrella before joining the queue at the cloakroom.
entries.zh: 佩格收起湿雨伞，然后到衣帽间排队。
